description: This file defines a Java JPA entity class 'FineractEntityToEntityMapping' which models a mapping between entities in the Fineract system. It includes properties for entity relation, from/to IDs, start/end dates, and methods for creating new mappings and updating existing ones based on JSON commands. The class handles persistence annotations, validation, and update logic with date comparisons.

classes.name: FineractEntityToEntityMapping
classes.description: A JPA entity representing a mapping between two entities in the Fineract system, including relation ID, from/to IDs, and start/end dates, with methods for creation and updating from JSON commands.

methods.name: newMap
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new mapping with specified relation, from/to IDs, start date, and end date.

methods.name: updateMap
methods.description: Updates the entity's fields based on a JsonCommand, tracking changes and ensuring date validity.
